title.narrative: Provision of Lifesaving and Early Response to Access of Emergency Health Services Among Crisis Affected and Vulnerable Populations at Risk of El-Nino Floods induced in Baardhere District, Gedo Region

description.narrative:
ltpgtlt/pgtltpgtltspangtIn this intervention, HDC seek to provide life-saving primary health services targeting vulnerable communities living in high risk flood and AWD/Cholera prone areas in order to reduce the impact of El-Nino, curb morbidities and mortalities attributed to common illnesses and disease outbreaks such as AWD/Cholera, measles, malaria and other illnesses in Baardhere District of Gedo Region. The project will also support the provision of Sexual Reproductive Health (SRH) services to women and adolescent girls to improve maternal health and reproductive health outcomes.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtThe intervention seeks to provide services at one static and one mobile facility through Baardheere General Hospital Longitude (2.33813:Latitude 42.2822226) for static services and one mobile outreach facility targeting 5 high burden IDP settlements which include Bula Esan Centre (Longitude 2.3561972 Latitude 42.2869587) Albaraka (Longitude 2.351629: Latitude 42.3018063) Haji Abdulahi (Longitude 2.3437715: Latitude 42.29311) Tawakal (Longitude 2.3560423: Latitude 42.2733219) Bulo Kuulow (Longitude 2.338778:Latitude 42.291658). A Cholera Treatment Unit (CTU) will be established in Baardhere General Hospital Latitude2.3383647 Longtitiude 42.2444642) to support AWD/Cholera treatment and cholera responses within the district.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtThe project is targeting to reach 22,000 beneficiries (4,060 men 7,900 women 4,950 girls and 5,090 boys) including vulnerable populations such as People With Disabilities (PWDs) and minority access essential primary health services through OPD consultations for treatment and prevention of common illnesses, immunization against Vaccine Preventable Diseases (VPDs) targeting U-5 children, Women of Child Bearing Age (WCBA) including Pregnant and Lactating Women (PLW) sexual reproductive health service such as Focused Antenatal Care (FANC) ,Post Natal Care (PNC), delivery assistance of expectant mothers AWD/Cholera treatment and response activities including early detection, investigation, and response to disease outbreaks. The hospital will also support referral services for cases referred from the mobile facility. HDC currently supports CEmONC services in the hospital thus will handle referral cases of complicated deliveries.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt
To support these services, the funds will be dedicated to procuring essential medical equipment and supplies for use in static and mobile facilities, staffing and facility operation costs, establish one CTU to strengthen cholera prevention and control support 24/7 hours ambulance to facilitate referral services and capacity building of health workers.
